text_block_list.text:
I escort Мэйсё Дото to the infirmary
after she
suffers an injury в тренировке.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! I'm always causing
you
trouble... Oogh.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll be back to training as soon

as—Ouch!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: If you're in pain, let's call it a day.

text_block_list.text:
B-but... I won't have any confidence to
spare if I
stop now...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going! This injury won't
h-hold me
down!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: I'd rather see you rest right now.
Do you want to try heading back for training?

text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going! This injury won't
h-hold me
back!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: I'd rather see you rest right now.
Do you want to try heading back for training?

text_block_list.text:
But, I really can't stand to stay put... If
the pain
gets too bad, I'll stop. So,
please!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list:
Training now might slow down the healing
process.

text_block_list.text: W-well...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: All right... I'll get some rest.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Guh... I've made a big mess of things
with this
injury... I'm so sorry.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, of course! Thank you so much,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Promise me you won't push yourself.

text_block_list.text:
I p-promise! I'll stop if the pain gets too
much!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Careful now... It should be fine if I don't
use too
much strength.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text: O-owowowwww!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
That was a fraction of my strength... Urk,
I can't
walk like this.
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Oh... I... think I can manage still. With
just a bit
more effort, maybe—
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: I want you to take it easy!

text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! That's right. I have that... promise
to keep!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Exerting any level of force seems to be a
taxing
endeavor, and her injury only
worsens.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото swallows her
disappointment,
choosing to rest until
she's fully healed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото keeps her strength in
check,
successfully returning to practice!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
